classification.difficultyReason: Convert three scores with different totals to exact percentages and rank their relative performance.

content.prompt: In his vocabulary tests last term, Mick scored 21 out of 25, 13 out of 15, and 17 out of 20. By expressing his scores as percentages, rank Mick’s efforts on the tests from best to worst.

answer.short:
2nd test: $86\frac{2}{3}\%$; 3rd test: $85\%$; 1st test: $84\%$.

Best to worst: 2nd test, 3rd test, 1st test.
answer.worked:
First test:
$$\begin{align*}\frac{21}{25}\times100\%&=\frac{2100}{25}\%\\\frac{21}{25}\times100\%&=84\%\end{align*}$$
Second test:
$$\begin{align*}\frac{13}{15}\times100\%&=\frac{260}{3}\%\\\frac{13}{15}\times100\%&=86\frac{2}{3}\%\end{align*}$$
Third test:
$$\begin{align*}\frac{17}{20}\times100\%&=\frac{1700}{20}\%\\\frac{17}{20}\times100\%&=85\%\end{align*}$$
Since $86\frac{2}{3}\%>85\%>84\%$, the ranking from best to worst is the 2nd test, 3rd test, then 1st test.
